commit_message: Remove redundant Audio adapter closure call
pr_title: GameEngine: complete Timeline Audio Track adapter
pr_body:
## Summary

- complete ADR 0126 Audio Track start/stop/seek/fade through ADR 0122 managed voices
- keep spatial playback on the existing ADR 0122 mixer path
- preserve asset resource reinsertion while removing a Clippy-rejected immediate closure call

Visual validation is not required because this change is runtime/audio logic only.
